subject: Mobile Development
title: Caching: Speed Through Memory
description: A short lesson to help you apply Caching: Speed Through Memory.

hook.text: Open Instagram. The feed appears before the network even responds. That's caching.

buildup.text: Apps store previously loaded data in memory or on disk to avoid repeated network calls.

discovery.text: Image caches can consume hundreds of megabytes. That's why 'clear cache' frees space.

twist.text: Stale caches show outdated data. Balancing freshness and speed is a constant tradeoff.

climax.text: Smart caching makes apps feel instant while quietly keeping data fresh.

punchline.text: Speed is showing old data while fetching new.

quiz.question: Why might clearing an app's cache free storage?
options: Caches store copies of previously loaded data
